g.text: you give the brief and approve the selection
the next is asked only when one is unsure or stuck
each selected task goes into a work cell of its own, and the cells run in parallel
Fix · broken, so repaired and verified again
protocol · pinned benchmarks · contributors' keys · signed ledger
every stage writes signed records, keyed by the task's content digest: nothing runs twice, and anyone can check how a task got in
